Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper Smiles Wearily As He Accepts The Award, His Eyes Shining With Pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Certificate And Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A New Branch, And The Person Lives On In That Branch.

He Sits Up In Bed, His Eyes Wide With Excitement.

JASPER (V.O)
It Was Just A Theory, But It Stuck With Me. And Now, As I Lie Here, I Wonder... What If It's True?

Jasper's Voice Begins To Shake, His Mind Racing With The Implications.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just Living In A Different Branch?

He Looks Around The Room, As If Searching For Evidence.

JASPER (V.O)
But If That's The Case, Then Why Can't I See The Other Branches? Why Can't I Talk To The Other Me?

Jasper's Voice Rises, His Mind Reaching A Breaking Point.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT ALIVE! I'M JUST A PART OF SOME BIG, COSMIC EXPERIMENT! I'M JUST A DROP IN THE OCEAN OF REALITY!

Jasper's Body Begins To Shake, His Eyes Rolling Back In His Head. He Sits Up In Bed, His Hair Standing On End.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT JASPER JENKINS! I'M JUST A QUANTUM ENTANGLED PARTICLE, FLOATING IN THE VACUUM OF SPACE!

The Camera Zooms In On Jasper's Face, His Eyes Wild And Unhinged.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO KNOWS THE TRUTH! I'M THE ONLY ONE WHO CAN SEE THE MULTIVERSE!

Jasper's Voice Drops To A Whisper, His Mind Reeling With The Implications.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M GOING TO TRY AND FIND THE OTHER ME. I'M GOING TO TRY AND FIND THE OTHER BRANCH.

The Camera Zooms Out, Showing Jasper's Frantic Body, His Mind Shattered By The Weight Of His Own Theories.

FADE TO BLACK.
